style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, slapstick deadpan, hard midday sun
shot: grounded low angle, holds at trough height, push-in on her face at the end
character: PIG: plump pink pig, deadpan heavy-lidded eyes, mud-streaked apron, trotters root/wipe/thump, limps on stiff right hind leg, delighted not pained
cast: GOAT: shaggy grey-brown billy goat, short horns, calm chewer, never speaks, bigger and closer to lens than the pig
props: MIC on a stand swings in 1.15-1.70, holds at her snout, dips in trough 8.95-9.50, stays wet. TROUGH: battered wood, scrap peels and dishwater, unchanged whole clip, one flat support, nothing stacked. SIGN: 'Дворец' painted on a warped board, torn and muddy, pinned on a fence post behind her; goat tears a strip free 8.40-8.95, post bare after
setting: yard by the unfinished house foundation, cracked slab, packed dirt
lighting: hard midday sun, crisp shadows, high exposure

audio.delivery: male low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry flat deadpan, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: even 4.3-4.4 syll/sec, one sentence across four bits with no pause between them, answers the mic, not declaiming. Nothing after 6.76
audio.lip_sync: pig talks like a person, mouth opens/closes clearly every syllable, her own voice, never voice over, answering the mic
audio.sfx: wet chewing, trough splash, apron wipe, burp, paper tear, goat chew, mic drip

timeline.a: silent. Hook: limps in, stiff right hind leg, delighted bounce, cheeks bulging
silent. Snout rams into trough, water and a leaf burst past lens; torn 'Дворец' sign flaps on the post behind her
silent. Mic swings in, stops at her snout; she recoils mid-chew, wet leaf on cheek
rocks back, body swaying, snout lifts dripping from the trough, deadpan stare on the mic, continues into next line
no pause. Rocks forward, still swaying, eyes slide toward the sign, deadpan
no pause. Chin dips toward the trough, swaying continues, deadpan stare
no pause, sentence ends here. Swaying eases into a lean, trotter already rising toward her snout for the wipe, deadpan stare, mouth closes on last syllable
silent. Wipes snout with the apron hem, smears more mud than she clears, chin lifted toward the sign
silent. Chest puffs, loud burp, trotter thumps sternum once
silent. Goat trots in, bigger and closer to lens than her, bites the sign's flapping corner
silent. Goat tears a strip of the sign free, paper crackles, post snaps back bare, chews unbothered
silent. Shrugs one shoulder, rams snout back into the trough; mic dips into the trough beside her snout
silent. Lifts head to stare into the lens, a peel stuck to her forehead, slow blink; goat still chewing the strip behind her shoulder
timeline.cam: push-in on her face, ending the shot

must_appear: delighted limp; snout rammed into the trough; mic parks at her snout; torn 'Дворец' sign visible from the start; body swaying hard through both lines; apron-hem wipe; audible burp; goat bigger than her, tearing the sign; her shrug back to the trough
negative_prompt: black bars, non-full-frame video; night, dusk, dim, moody, low key, lamp, candle, neon, dark scene, underexposed; human hands; second pig, second goat, other animals; duplicate trough, mic, or sign; floating objects, stacked props; cuts, jump cuts; extra limbs; pig reciting instead of answering the mic; rushed delivery, slow speech, drawn-out delivery, pause mid-sentence, speech after 5.40, foreign accent, English speech; static pose; subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, readable text except the 'Дворец' sign lettering
